comparison.objective: Feed a strip through a roller mill using a hold-to-run control; candidate adjusts a damper and operates a guarded cycle control.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained button press plus timed strip release before a nip versus tool engagement, fine adjustment, locking, and repeated cycle inspection.
comparison.success_condition: Strip drawn through, rollers stopped, and hands kept clear versus repeatable non-bottoming stops with no overload, rebound, or setting drift.
comparison.reason: Shared physical control actuation is generic; the record tests safe material feeding, not mechanical commissioning.
